At MAI, we’re building the world’s most capable AI systems, with humanity at the center of every decision.
 
 
 
 
 Humanist Superintelligence means building the world’s most advanced AI systems designed to stay controllable, aligned, and firmly in service of humanity. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Our Values 
 
 
 
 
 
 Kindness 
 
 Trust 
 
 Quality 
 
 Simplicity 
 
 Safety & Security 
 
 Evaluation 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How we work shapes what we build. A team that communicates with care and makes space for different perspectives builds better.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Trust is earned through consistency and honesty. We’re as clear about our limits as we are about our strengths.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We aspire to create the very best models in the world: accurate, reliable, and genuinely useful across the work that matters most.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We design for clarity so you can focus on the work, not the technology.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We believe responsible and capable AI aren’t in tension. We build with privacy, security, and human rights in mind.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We test rigorously, listen closely, and improve constantly. Our models get better because we never stop measuring.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Kindness 
 
 
 How we work shapes what we build. A team that communicates with care and makes space for different perspectives builds better. 
 
 
 
 
 Trust 
 
 
 Trust is earned through consistency and honesty. We’re as clear about our limits as we are about our strengths. 
 
 
 
 
 Quality 
 
 
 We aspire to create the very best models in the world: accurate, reliable, and genuinely useful across the work that matters most. 
 
 
 
 
 Simplicity 
 
 
 We design for clarity so you can focus on the work, not the technology. 
 
 
 
 
 Safety & Security 
 
 
 We believe responsible and capable AI aren’t in tension. We build with privacy, security, and human rights in mind. 
 
 
 
 
 Evaluation 
 
 
 We test rigorously, listen closely, and improve constantly. Our models get better because we never stop measuring. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Join us
 
 
 
We’re a lean, talent-dense team of explorers, researchers, and full-stack engineers. We move fast, sweat the details, and operate at frontier scale with a roadmap to build the world’s most powerful AI models. Most importantly, we’re united by the belief that doing this right is the only way to do it at all.
 
If our mission resonates with you, we’d love to talk.
 
 
 Explore jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Key Locations
 
 
 We have offices in cities across the globe. 
Where will you join? 
 
 
 
 
 
 Mountain View 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Sunlit sprawl between the bay and the coastal hills, in the restless heart of the technology industry, where founders, bold ideas, and ambition are never in short supply. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Redmond 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Where Microsoft began – set among the evergreen forests, lakes, and mountains of the Pacific Northwest, a calm and grounded place built for deep work and the long view. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 New York 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Positioned among landmark architecture, tree-lined plazas, and one of Manhattan’s liveliest creative quarters. With the city’s culture right at its doorstep, it’s a hub of innovation and energy. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 London 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 A global capital where centuries of history meet a thriving AI scene, alive with the talent and ideas shaping what comes next. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Zurich 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Lake Zurich, the Alps, and Swiss precision, home to some of Europe’s sharpest engineering minds and a deep belief in doing things exactly right. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Paris 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Centuries of art, philosophy, and scientific ambition along the Seine, now one of the world’s fastest-growing AI hubs. A city that has always believed the most powerful ideas should also be the most human. 
 
 Explore Jobs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 We are building a practical superintelligence, rooted in the challenges of real people and businesses. This is the world’s most advanced AI designed to address our biggest problems and always remain under human control.  
 
 
 
 
 Mustafa Suleyman

 What is Power Platform? 
 
 
 
 How can I try Power Platform? 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Why Power Platform 
 
 
Turn business intent into impact</h2> "> 
 
Turn business intent into impact
 
 
 
 
 Bring apps, agents, data, and automation together to build smarter, secure solutions. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Start with intent, not technical constraints 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Empower teams to move from idea to impact with clarity, speed, and control. Describe the outcome, and Power Platform uses AI to guide the development of apps and workflows, connect to your data, and stay governed and secure. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Start with intent, not technical constraints
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Unified data across apps and agents 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 When data is unified and governed, apps lead with relevance, agents act with awareness, and automation runs reliably. Microsoft Dataverse delivers the secure, shared foundation that makes this possible. 
 
 
 
 
 
See how Dataverse powers solutions
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified data across apps and agents
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Built-in security for enterprise trust, governance, and control 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Get the security and governance you need to adopt AI with confidence. IT maintains oversight across every solution, while developers and makers build faster within approved guardrails, ensuring solutions scale consistently and securely across the business. 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore governance and security
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built-in security for enterprise trust, governance, and control
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Connected across your ecosystem 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Build the way you want—from low-code to pro-code—with AI-assistance and code-first extensibility. Over 1,500 connectors work across the services and systems where your business already runs, providing a foundation that lets solutions grow without costly rebuilds. You’ll unify data and processes across apps, use agents to recommend next best actions, and automate end-to-end workflows to remove friction. 
 
 
 
 
 
Browse connectors and integrations
 
 
 
 
 
 
Connected across your ecosystem

Move content from draft to publish

Speed up finance approvals
